messages:
olivia (PM): ok team — looping everyone in. I want to lock down the acceptance criteria for the docs-as-spec approach for Quickstarts and the PRD gating. We need a minimal, testable bar that we can ship without over-indexing on edge polish. thoughts?

sasha (Docs): +1. propose: 3 runnable quickstarts (hosted api, dedicated, private/vpc), each with a tiny example app and CI smoke test that runs in ~2m.

anna (Eng Lead): agree on the 3 surfaces. add: at least one example must exercise streaming + tool calling. otherwise we miss common infra patterns.

samir (SRE): CI smoke tests should not hit prod models. use a small local test model or mocked responses. failing tests should block merges to main.

dennis (PM): customer-driven asks: enterprise customers asked for a clear example of Private deployment + KMS integration. can we include a checklist item for KMS keys + audit log snippet?

olivia (PM): yes — include a short KMS guide and an example config file. but that can be an "MVP doc" (concise, copy-paste) not a full compliance playbook. we can defer deeper audit-log walkthroughs to a follow-up doc.

anna (Eng Lead): scope note: to keep MVP tractable, omit multi-model routing and advanced quantization configs. we should document them as "future work" and list acceptance triggers.

sasha (Docs): acceptance checklist proposal (short):
- runnable quickstart per surface (hosted/dedicated/private)
- each quickstart includes: minimal app, expected output, config snippet, required env vars
- one example demonstrates streaming + function call
- KMS example for private quickstart (placeholder creds + notes)
- CI smoke test that uses a mock or tiny test model
- a one-paragraph security note and a link to eng-security doc
- list of known limitations / edge cases (no more than 6 items)

samir (SRE): add: CI must assert latency < 2s for single-turn hosted example (mocked latency threshold). also assert that error codes are surfaced as 4xx/5xx appropriately.

olivia (PM): good. also include acceptance criteria for "docs-as-spec" PR gate: docs must be merged before feature code, or at worst same PR with docs reviewed. we should make docs review required by at least one Docs owner + Eng owner.

dennis (PM): customer blocking asks: for one strategic customer, they want an end-to-end demo that shows failover to a cheaper variant when capacity is constrained. can we provide a small note + example config?

anna (Eng Lead): we can provide pseudocode config and a local mock to illustrate routing fallback. but full automated failover demo is out of MVP scope. we'll mark it as "example only".

sasha (Docs): edge cases to capture in known-limitations section:
- streaming interruptions (how to resume / client tips)
- long-context truncation behavior
- token accounting differences across quantized variants
- function-calling schema mismatches
- credential refresh races for private deployments
- model fallback semantical differences (quality regressions)

olivia (PM): outstanding decisions:
1) must docs include a full end-to-end terraform snippet for private? (dennis wants it)
2) do we require an automated smoke test that runs on every docs change?
3) ownership signoff matrix (who is final approver)

dennis (PM): my take: 1) include a minimal terraform example but label it experimental. 2) yes: automated smoke on docs merges for quickstarts. 3) final approver = Eng Lead + Docs Owner.

anna (Eng Lead): +1 to dennis, but add SRE signoff for any changes touching private networking or KMS.

samir (SRE): I'll volunteer to own the CI smoke test template and the SRE signoff checklist.

docs-bot: new checklist created: "quickstart-doc-as-spec-mvp" — items: runnable-hosted, runnable-dedicated, runnable-private, streaming-example, kms-snippet, ci-smoke, security-note, limitations-list.

olivia (PM): next steps: sasha to author initial docs PR using checklist; anna + samir to review for eng + infra; dennis and i to validate customer-specific snippets. target: merge by Fri (5 working days).

sasha (Docs): will start the PR today. i'll keep examples intentionally tiny (10-20 lines) and include a repo link for full reference.

anna (Eng Lead): ping me when PR is up, i'll allocate review time.

dennis (PM): i'll draft the customer-specific failover snippet and KMS terraform placeholder — will post in the PR as Gists.

olivia (PM): awesome. if anyone sees scope creep call it out early :) :raised_hands: 

sasha (Docs): noted. keeping an explicit "out of scope" section in the PR description.

olivia (PM): thanks all — marking this thread resolved for planning. we'll track progress in the PR. :white_check_mark:
